Exact player 'Cirren insights' asks Cirren to assess the conflicting claims. Owning cirren-skills.csv Insight +8 (WIS5 proficiency3); predeclared active DC13 for credibility from ~80ft in nighttime lighting. Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt batch a040ac50d029e2f3cd54719d16f7ca7a d20 face4+8=12, fails by1. Cirren cannot reliably discern which account is true; no mind-reading, confirmation of lawful custody, new facts or expenditure. The player interrupted the response after the visible roll and before the previous recovery write completed; listing D330 and head confirmed only preceding greeting chunk existed. Preserve actual roll in this combined original response chunk, not a reroll.

Exact player 'What did they steal and where are you taking them?' V asks these two questions from camp without new movement or threat. Leader calls back 'Silver. From our employer's house. We're taking them back there to answer for it.' This is his deliberately false explanation consistent with fixed ransom abduction; no actual theft, employer identity, destination, magistrate or lawful authority established. Bound woman replies 'We've never worked for these men!' The statements are competing claims, not automatically verified facts. Leader remains impatient, group still stopped on road about80ft from camp, no new approach, attack, pursuit, initiative or contested check. Cirren quietly says he cannot tell which account is true from here, but the man has not named an authority. V next choice.
